{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_rows = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]

# Display the duplicate patient_ids and their rows
duplicate_rows[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'site', 'arm', 'severity', 'age', 'sex', 'assay_batch', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']].sort_values('patient_id')"}
